Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sep 11, 9:25 am, "Lord Soth of Dargaard Keep, The Knight of the
Black Rose" wrote:

> By the text of Revelation of Ecstasy I can use in a tapped minion?

Yes, you can use RoE on an already tapped minion.
The only targeting restrictions are that the minion belong to your
prey and that it be ready.
(i.e. can't target your predator or cross-table, can't target minion
in torpor)

For complete understanding, if the two cards had the same - Do X and Y
- format, why RoE cloud be made and not EM?

Do exist some general rule about this?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


For one, X and Y are both possible. For the other, they are not (only one is
possible).

The difference is that for your Eternal Mask case, you can't do X because of the
lack of legal targets for that effect.

EM: "You may burn this card and the chosen vampire during any untap phase."

The effect is "burn this card and the chosen vampire". It has two targets: "this
card" and "the chosen vampire". One of those isn't in play, and so is not a
legal target, so the effect cannot be used.

RoE: "Tap and place a counter on one of your prey's ready minions."

The effect has only one target: a ready minion controlled by your prey.

Since there is a legal target, you can do it.

You tap him (the effect can be applied to an already-tapped minion) and you put
a counter on him.
